name: context-milvus
description: Semantic code search for Codex backed by a Milvus vector database

interface.shortDescription: Semantic code search over your repository
interface.longDescription: Indexes the repository into Milvus with AST-aware chunking, then answers natural-language code queries over MCP: semantic search, incremental indexing, call-graph analysis, and — when ADR_ENABLED is set — the ADR decision-memory tools that explain why the code is the way it is.
